title: Extend Board Selection
description: Extend elements/board selection so holding left button opens selection with rectangle and lasso methods, additive/subtractive/invertive modes, node/edge/both targets, and directional partial-vs-enclosing behavior.
summary: Implemented configurable board area selection for rectangle and lasso methods with additive, subtractive, and invertive modes. Added node/edge/nodes&edges targeting, directional partial-vs-enclosing selection semantics, active selection overlay rendering, React BoardCanvas props for selection configuration, and focused inline Vitest coverage. Routed @elements/board build and test targets through the existing script.ts per repo conventions. Verified @elements/board:test and @elements/board:build; build required redirecting Nx workspace/cache directories into the ticket folder because the shared .nx workspace-data cache was locked.
